MP Govt to Provide Air Ambulance for Wild Animal Attack Victims

The Madhya Pradesh government will provide air ambulance services to individuals severely injured in wild animal attacks. Additionally, Chief Minister Mohan Yadav announced that families of victims who lose their lives due to attacks by wild elephants will receive ₹25 lakh in compensation. These announcements were made as part of significant welfare measures for affected individuals and families.
